text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No information is available on overdosage in humans. If overdose with LUMIGAN ® 0.01% and 0.03% (bimatoprost ophthalmic solution) occurs, treatment should be symptomatic. In oral (by gavage) mouse and rat studies, doses up to 100 mg/kg/day did not produce any toxicity. This dose expressed as mg/m 2 is at least 70 times higher than the accidental dose of one bottle of LUMIGAN ® 0.03% for a 10 kg child.
